{{Quote|Ah, this guy was an arms dealer. Made his bank selling weapons to the bad guys. Oh…and the good.|DJ, to [[Finn]], on Korfé Bennux-Ai|<ref name="Episode 8">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>}}
'''Korfé Bennux-Ai''' was a [[Gender|male]] individual<ref name="TLJ ICS" /> who purchased<ref name="POV 213">{{InsiderCite|213|A Certain Point of View}}</ref> and then owned the custom [[Yacht|Star Yacht]] ''[[Libertine]]''. He was an [[arms dealer]] who sold [[starfighter]]s. When he visited [[Canto Bight]] after a failed sale with [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s, the ''Libertine'' was stolen by [[DJ]], a criminal and [[slicer]] with no allegiances.<ref name="TLJ ICS" />
